classification.difficultyReason: Construct two residue classes across the negative and positive interval, preserving the specified mod5 remainders. Routine number-line representation with negative members.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Mark on the number line all integers between $-10$ and $5$ congruent to $2$ modulo $5$.

answer.worked:
Each required integer is $2$ more than a multiple of $5$.

$$\begin{align*}-8&=5\times(-2)+2\\-3&=5\times(-1)+2\\2&=5\times0+2\end{align*}$$

Mark $-8$, $-3$ and $2$ on the number line.

spec.description: Authored solution number line with integer ticks from −10 to 5 and closed points at −8, −3 and 2.
spec.mathematics: Integers in the requested interval of the form 5k+2.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Mark on the number line all integers between $-10$ and $5$ congruent to $3$ modulo $5$.

answer.worked:
Each required integer is $3$ more than a multiple of $5$.

$$\begin{align*}-7&=5\times(-2)+3\\-2&=5\times(-1)+3\\3&=5\times0+3\end{align*}$$

Mark $-7$, $-2$ and $3$ on the number line.

spec.description: Authored solution number line with integer ticks from −10 to 5 and closed points at −7, −2 and 3.
spec.mathematics: Integers in the requested interval of the form 5k+3.
